what.text: This page follows refugees from Liberia living in Côte d'Ivoire, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1156 Liberian refugees in Côte d'Ivoire, 22.6% of all refugees from Liberia.
Côte d'Ivoire is the largest host of Liberian refugees, followed by the United States, Ghana and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Liberia in 1989 and 1990, with the NPFL, and from 2000 to 2003, with LURD and MODEL.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1991 and 1993 to 1997.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 271831 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 359351, at the end of 1994, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Côte d'Ivoire.
These are year-end totals for Côte d'Ivoire only, reported to UNHCR.
